analysis_source:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,csv
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
e4=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1'
e5=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1'
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
# 明确只有汇总均值/离散度，避免把24家机构原始分布当成已公开输入。
result_path=e5/'result.json'
result=json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result['individual_dealer_forecasts_available']=False
result['full_forecast_distribution_available']=False
result['published_summary_statistics_available']=True
result['conclusion']=result['conclusion'].replace('及其分布存在','及其离散度汇总存在')
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
for p in [e5/'机构预期时段匹配_来源结论.md',root/'docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']:
    b=p.read_bytes()
    text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    old='接受长期机构预期分布确实存在'
    new='接受长期机构预期汇总及离散度确实存在，未取得24家逐份预测或完整分布'
    assert text.count(old)==1
    after=text.replace(old,new,1)
    if p.name=='RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md':
        assert after[after.index('## 十、'):]==text[text.index('## 十、'):]
    assert p.read_bytes()==b
    p.write_text(after,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol_checks={}
input_checks={}
source_checks={}
for d in [e4,e5]:
    freeze=json.loads((d/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    protocol_checks[d.name]=sha(d/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
    assert protocol_checks[d.name]
    for rel,digest in freeze['input_hashes'].items():
        input_checks[rel]=sha(root/rel)==digest
        assert input_checks[rel],rel
    if d==e4:
        receipt=json.loads((d/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
    else:
        receipt=[json.loads((d/'source_receipt.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))]
    for item in receipt:
        rel=item['source_path']
        source_checks[rel]=sha(root/rel)==item['source_sha256']
        assert source_checks[rel],rel
program_paths=json.loads(r"""["reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/登记程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/固定月接口程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/原件获取程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/原件渲染程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/固定月分析程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/登记程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/原调查获取渲染程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/调查时段分析程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/两项中文结论程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/长期文档更新程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/最终必要核对程序记录.json"]""")
program_checks={}
for rel in program_paths:
    p=root/rel
    d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    ok=hashlib.sha256(d['analysis_source'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()==d['analysis_source_sha256']
    program_checks[rel]=ok
    assert ok,rel
with (e4/'七券公告与提前计划对齐.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
    alignment=list(csv.DictReader(f))
r4=json.loads((e4/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(alignment)==7
assert sum(Decimal(r['announcement_amount_usd']) for r in alignment)==Decimal(285)*Decimal(10)**9
assert all(Decimal(r['announcement_amount_usd'])==Decimal(r['prior_plan_amount_usd']) for r in alignment)
assert len({r['printed_release_shanghai'] for r in alignment})==3
assert r4['amount_changes_vs_prior_plan']==0
assert all(not r['new_model_fits'] and not r['new_accounts'] and not r['goal_achieved'] for r in [r4,result])
state=(root/'docs/PROJECT_STATE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
decisions=(root/'docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
sections=[
 state[state.index('### 5.6 '):state.index('## 6. ')],
 state[state.index('### E4：'):state.index('### 接手操作清单')],
 decisions[decisions.index('### R62｜'):decisions.index('## 八、')]
]
links={}
for text in sections:
    for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
        if ref.startswith(('https:','http:')):
            continue
        links[ref]=(root/'docs'/ref.split('#',1)[0]).exists()
        assert links[ref],ref
updates=json.loads((e5/'长期文档更新回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
configs_unchanged={}
authority=json.loads((e4/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['authority_config_snapshots']
for rel,info in updates['config_changes'].items():
    before=authority[rel]
    after=json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    allowed=set(info['modified_keys'])
    configs_unchanged[rel]={k:v for k,v in before.items() if k not in allowed}=={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k not in allowed}
    assert configs_unchanged[rel],rel
    assert after['goal_achieved'] is False and after['orders_authorized'] is False
assert not list(e4.rglob('*.py')) and not list(e5.rglob('*.py'))
check={
 'at':stamp,'status':'PASS_NECESSARY_SOURCES_AND_DOCUMENTS',
 'protocol_hashes_match':protocol_checks,'frozen_prior_inputs_unchanged':input_checks,
 'official_raw_source_hashes_match':source_checks,'complete_program_hashes_match':program_checks,
 'new_document_links_exist':links,'all_non_progress_config_fields_unchanged':configs_unchanged,
 'saved_alignment_count':7,'saved_gross_billion_usd':285,'saved_new_amount_deviations':0,'saved_announcement_roots':3,
 'complete_relevant_pdf_pages_inspected':8,
 'dealer_summary_not_full_distribution':True,
 'new_stock_returns_loaded':False,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,'goal_achieved':False,
 'scope':'只核对本轮直接来源、冻结协议、保存对齐数、新链接和进度配置；没有全库回测、全仓测试或安全审计。',
}
(e5/'最终必要核对.json').write_text(json.dumps(check,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
for d in [e4,e5]:
    receipt_path=d/'execution_receipt.json'
    assert not receipt_path.exists(),'最终回执已存在，不覆盖'
    own=[rel for rel in program_paths if rel.startswith(str(d.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/')+'/')]
    receipt={
     'at':stamp,'study_directory':str(d.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),
     'status':'COMPLETED_BOUNDED_SOURCE_STAGE_NO_MODEL',
     'full_program_records':own,
     'shared_program_records':[p for p in program_paths if p not in own and any(n in p for n in ['两项中文结论','长期文档更新','最终必要核对'])],
     'necessary_check_receipt':'reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/最终必要核对.json',
     'official_source_objects':18 if d==e4 else 1,
     'new_stock_returns_loaded':False,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,'goal_achieved':False,
     'output_hashes':{str(p.relative_to(d)).replace('\\','/'):sha(p) for p in sorted(d.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p!=receipt_path},
    }
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'必要核对':check['status'],'新来源原件':len(source_checks),'完整程序':len(program_checks),'链接':len(links),'核读PDF页':8,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'源码改动':0,'目标完成':False},ensure_ascii=False))
